source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the radius of a star (PDF 174).

blocks.text: Sitare ka radius Wien ke displacement qanoon aur Stefan-Boltzmann qanoon se nikala ja sakta hai. Pehle Wien ke qanoon se chotti ki wavelength se sitare ka satah ka darja hararat T nikala jata hai. Luminosity L naape gaye radiant flux intensity aur sitare ke faasle se milti hai (L = 4 pi d^2 F). Phir Stefan-Boltzmann qanoon radius deta hai: r = [L / (4 pi sigma T^4)] ka square root.

Sooraj ka spectrum taqreeban 500 nm par chotti par hai, aur us ki luminosity 3.85 x 10^26 W hai. Us ka radius andaza lagayein. Hal: T = b / lambda_max = 2.9 x 10^-3 m K / 500 x 10^-9 m = 5800 K. Phir r = [L / (4 pi sigma T^4)] ka square root = [3.85 x 10^26 / (4 x 3.14 x 5.67 x 10^-8 x (5800)^4)] ka square root = 6.9 x 10^8 m, jo Sooraj ke naape gaye radius (taqreeban 7.0 x 10^8 m) se milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Do sitaron ki luminosity barabar hai, lekin aik ka satah ka darja hararat doosre ka dugna hai. Un ke radius ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: L = 4 pi r^2 sigma T^4, is liye barabar L ke liye r, 1/T^2 ke mutanasib hai: garam sitare ka radius thande sitare ka aik chauthai hai.

items: Wien ka qanoon T deta; flux aur faasla L dete.
Stefan-Boltzmann r = sqrt(L / 4 pi sigma T^4) deta.
